name: t5s_neutral_pc
description: Phase 3 T5s NEUTRALITY CONTROL (thermodynamics). The t5probe_pc run (isnd=5, iwnd=0 -- the known zero-shear pulse cell) re-run with the IDENTICAL environment supplied through the external sounding path: isnd=7 + input_sounding generated from the WK82 reference profile, no wind. Deck differs from t5probe_pc's in exactly 2 keys (isnd 5->7, and iwnd stays 0). GATE (docs/plan-science-hurdles-2026-09-02.md section 4.1): CM1's base state th0/qv0/prs0 at t=0 must match t5probe_pc's to interpolation accuracy (|dtheta| < 0.1 K, |dqv| < 0.05 g/kg at every level), CM1's own t=0 cape/cin output must agree with input_sounding.report.json to the parcel-method tolerance, and the storm must be the SAME pulse cell (peak w within 5 %, same peak time +/- 5 min). Not bitwise -- the file is interpolated onto CM1's levels. If this fails, isnd=7 is not what this project believes it is and nothing downstream of it can be trusted.
